snippet.title: Call of Elyndra – Early Gameplay Footage (Farming & Adventure RPG)
snippet.description:
Take your first look at Call of Elyndra, an upcoming HD2D indie game blending cozy farming, Zelda-inspired adventure, and magical puzzle-solving. This early development gameplay footage offers a glimpse into the world of Elyndra — a land full of mystery, danger, and discovery.

🌱 Build and grow your farm with unique crops
⚔️ Explore dungeons & battle fearsome creatures
🧩 Solve mystical puzzles tied to ancient relics
💫 Strengthen bonds with characters across the world

🎮 Call of Elyndra is currently in development. Play the free demo and wishlist on Steam today to follow the journey!
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2902600/Call_of_Elyndra/

Stay connected with the community:
🐦 Twitter: https://x.com/Quorum_Games
💬 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/TGzGJRmGdQ

#CallOfElyndra #IndieGame #FarmingAdventure
